geometry.description: Six WR-90 sub-cavities along z (Fig. 7 axes: x along a, y along b, z along the filter). Iris sequence: l_ext | CAP | l_int | IND | l_int | CAP | l_int | IND | l_int | CAP | l_ext (3 capacitive, 2 inductive irises, k1 = +0.0248, k2 = -0.0248). Inductive iris: wall of thickness t_ind with a full-height aperture of width w (Fig. 4 top). Capacitive ('quasi-capacitive') iris: wall of thickness t_cap with a full-width horizontal slot of height h, with protrusions of width g (Fig. 6 left). SMA probes in the first and last cavity (top face); port 1 critically coupled at 2 K, port 2 minimal pin.

inconsistencies.description: Capacitive iris height: text gives the chosen h = 0.93 mm (k = 0.0248; Fig. 6 right marker digitized at h = 0.928), Table 1 design gives h = 1.000 mm. The text says h was re-optimized in the final CST stage, so 1.000 is presumably final; note the Fig. 6 right curve gives k1(1.000) = 0.0270, not 0.0248.
inconsistencies.proposal: use Table 1 (h = 1.000 mm) for Table 2 / Fig. 10; use 0.93 mm only for the Fig. 6 coupling check

inconsistencies.description: Inductive iris width: text says w = 8.90 mm at k = -0.0248, but the Fig. 5 left marker sits at w = 9.06 mm (k = -0.0250). Re-digitized curve: k2(8.90) = -0.02377, i.e. 4.2% below the stated -0.0248 (4.9% vs the marker value); the curve reaches -0.0248 at w = 9.03 mm (earlier '2%' was wrong)
inconsistencies.evidence: Fig. 5 left vector marker vs p. 15 text / Table 1
inconsistencies.proposal: use Table 1 w = 8.900; note the ~4% k mismatch as a figure-vs-text inconsistency

inconsistencies.description: Table 1 'thermally expanded' column is not a uniform scaling: w and h are 0.060-0.087 mm larger than 2K x (a_300/a_2) (exactly +60 um = 2 x 30 um coating for w and h), while a, b, l, t are pure expansion. Coating is applied inconsistently.
inconsistencies.proposal: for the 300 K Q0 column of Table 2, reproduce with the printed col. 2 dimensions as-is
